<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 390 844">
  <defs>
    <linearGradient id="bg" x1="0" y1="0" x2="0" y2="1">
      <stop offset="0" stop-color="#FFBBCD"/>
      <stop offset="1" stop-color="#FFFFFF"/>
    </linearGradient>
    <filter id="shadow" x="-30%" y="-30%" width="160%" height="170%">
      <feGaussianBlur in="SourceAlpha" stdDeviation="4"/>
      <feOffset dy="4"/>
      <feComponentTransfer><feFuncA type="linear" slope=".25"/></feComponentTransfer>
      <feMerge><feMergeNode/><feMergeNode in="SourceGraphic"/></feMerge>
    </filter>
    <filter id="soft" x="-30%" y="-30%" width="160%" height="170%">
      <feGaussianBlur in="SourceAlpha" stdDeviation="5"/>
      <feOffset dx="2" dy="4"/>
      <feComponentTransfer><feFuncA type="linear" slope=".22"/></feComponentTransfer>
      <feMerge><feMergeNode/><feMergeNode in="SourceGraphic"/></feMerge>
    </filter>
  </defs>

  <rect x="0" y="0" width="390" height="844" fill="url(#bg)"/>

  <!-- status bar -->
  <rect x="0" y="0" width="390" height="44" fill="#FFFFFF"/>
  <text x="25" y="27" font-family="Roboto, Arial" font-size="14" font-weight="900" fill="#000000">9:41</text>
  <line x1="326" y1="27" x2="341" y2="27" stroke="#000000" stroke-width="2"/>
  <line x1="326" y1="24" x2="341" y2="24" stroke="#000000" stroke-width="2"/>
  <line x1="326" y1="21" x2="341" y2="21" stroke="#000000" stroke-width="2"/>
  <circle cx="351" cy="23" r="2" fill="#000000"/>
  <line x1="346" y1="27" x2="351" y2="20" stroke="#000000" stroke-width="1.8"/>
  <line x1="351" y1="20" x2="356" y2="27" stroke="#000000" stroke-width="1.8"/>
  <rect x="364" y="17" width="22" height="12" rx="3" fill="none" stroke="#000000" stroke-width="1.5"/>
  <rect x="386" y="21" width="2" height="4" rx="1" fill="#000000"/>
  <rect x="366" y="19" width="17" height="8" rx="2" fill="#000000"/>

  <!-- app background content -->
  <text x="25" y="86" font-family="Roboto, Arial" font-size="25" font-weight="300" fill="#FFFFFF">hey</text>
  <circle cx="344" cy="81" r="22" fill="#F99DAA" opacity=".58"/>
  <circle cx="344" cy="75" r="6" fill="#FFFFFF"/>
  <ellipse cx="344" cy="88" rx="11" ry="7" fill="#FFFFFF"/>
  <line x1="332" y1="81" x2="326" y2="81" stroke="#FFFFFF" stroke-width="2"/>

  <!-- decorative bird -->
  <g filter="url(#soft)">
    <ellipse cx="195" cy="173" rx="86" ry="65" fill="#F38093" opacity=".72"/>
    <ellipse cx="215" cy="156" rx="49" ry="38" fill="#FFFFFF" opacity=".88"/>
    <circle cx="245" cy="137" r="25" fill="#FFFFFF"/>
    <polygon points="270,137 291,145 270,151" fill="#FFD663"/>
    <circle cx="252" cy="132" r="4" fill="#000000"/>
    <ellipse cx="189" cy="171" rx="52" ry="20" fill="#FFBBCD" transform="rotate(25 189 171)"/>
    <line x1="222" y1="193" x2="222" y2="211" stroke="#F38093" stroke-width="3"/>
    <line x1="238" y1="190" x2="238" y2="208" stroke="#F38093" stroke-width="3"/>
    <line x1="218" y1="211" x2="226" y2="211" stroke="#F38093" stroke-width="3"/>
    <line x1="234" y1="208" x2="242" y2="208" stroke="#F38093" stroke-width="3"/>
  </g>

  <!-- circular decorative image -->
  <g filter="url(#shadow)">
    <circle cx="76" cy="227" r="43" fill="#F99DAA"/>
    <circle cx="76" cy="227" r="38" fill="#FCFCFE"/>
    <circle cx="92" cy="213" r="8" fill="#FFD663"/>
    <polygon points="45,253 65,230 76,242 87,225 108,253" fill="#F38093"/>
    <polygon points="45,253 65,230 76,242 87,225 108,253" fill="#F38093" opacity=".75"/>
    <circle cx="76" cy="227" r="38" fill="none" stroke="#FFFFFF" stroke-width="3"/>
  </g>

  <!-- background activity cards -->
  <g filter="url(#shadow)">
    <rect x="24" y="316" width="342" height="74" rx="20" fill="#FFFFFF" opacity=".74"/>
    <circle cx="57" cy="353" r="21" fill="#F38093"/>
    <text x="57" y="359" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Roboto, Arial" font-size="16" font-weight="700" fill="#FFFFFF">M</text>
    <text x="91" y="346" font-family="Roboto, Arial" font-size="16" font-weight="700" fill="#000000">Maya Wilson</text>
    <text x="91" y="369" font-family="Roboto, Arial" font-size="13" font-weight="400" fill="#50555C">Chirping nearby · 2 min ago</text>
  </g>
  <g filter="url(#shadow)">
    <rect x="24" y="405" width="342" height="74" rx="20" fill="#FFFFFF" opacity=".74"/>
    <circle cx="57" cy="442" r="21" fill="#FFBBCD"/>
    <text x="57" y="448" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Roboto, Arial" font-size="16" font-weight="700" fill="#000000">L</text>
    <text x="91" y="435" font-family="Roboto, Arial" font-size="16" font-weight="700" fill="#000000">Liam Carter</text>
    <text x="91" y="458" font-family="Roboto, Arial" font-size="13" font-weight="400" fill="#50555C">Added a new bird · Today</text>
  </g>

  <!-- dimmed confirmation surface -->
  <rect x="0" y="44" width="390" height="728" fill="#000000" opacity=".13"/>

  <!-- confirmation dialog -->
  <g filter="url(#shadow)">
    <rect x="31" y="492" width="328" height="205" rx="31" fill="#FFFFFF"/>
    <circle cx="195" cy="525" r="25" fill="#FFBBCD"/>
    <circle cx="187" cy="520" r="6" fill="#FFFFFF"/>
    <ellipse cx="198" cy="531" rx="13" ry="7" fill="#FFFFFF"/>
    <polygon points="210,521 223,526 210,530" fill="#FFD663"/>
    <text x="195" y="579" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Roboto, Arial" font-size="21" font-weight="700" fill="#000000">Log out?</text>
    <text x="195" y="607" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Roboto, Arial" font-size="15" font-weight="400" fill="#50555C">Are you sure you want to leave hey?</text>
    <text x="195" y="629" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Roboto, Arial" font-size="13" font-weight="400" fill="#ADB3BC">You can come back anytime.</text>
    <g>
      <rect x="54" y="651" width="127" height="38" rx="22" fill="#F4F4F6"/>
      <text x="117" y="676" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Roboto, Arial" font-size="14" font-weight="700" fill="#000000">Cancel</text>
    </g>
    <g>
      <rect x="209" y="651" width="127" height="38" rx="22" fill="#F88D9C"/>
      <text x="272" y="676" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Roboto, Arial" font-size="14" font-weight="900" fill="#FFFFFF">Logout</text>
    </g>
  </g>

  <!-- bottom navigation -->
  <rect x="0" y="772" width="390" height="72" fill="#FFFFFF" opacity=".94"/>
  <line x1="0" y1="772" x2="390" y2="772" stroke="#F38093" stroke-width="1" opacity=".35"/>
  <g>
    <polygon points="31,799 42,790 53,799 53,813 32,813" fill="none" stroke="#000000" stroke-width="2"/>
    <polyline points="27,800 42,787 57,800" fill="none" stroke="#000000" stroke-width="2"/>
    <text x="42" y="834" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Roboto, Arial" font-size="11" font-weight="400" fill="#000000">Home</text>
  </g>
  <g>
    <circle cx="119" cy="797" r="7" fill="none" stroke="#000000" stroke-width="2"/>
    <ellipse cx="119" cy="810" rx="12" ry="6" fill="none" stroke="#000000" stroke-width="2"/>
    <text x="119" y="834" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Roboto, Arial" font-size="11" font-weight="400" fill="#000000">Friends</text>
  </g>
  <g>
    <ellipse cx="195" cy="800" rx="14" ry="9" fill="none" stroke="#F38093" stroke-width="2"/>
    <circle cx="202" cy="795" r="5" fill="none" stroke="#F38093" stroke-width="2"/>
    <polygon points="207,795 218,799 207,803" fill="#F38093"/>
    <text x="195" y="834" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Roboto, Arial" font-size="11" font-weight="400" fill="#000000">Birds</text>
  </g>
  <g>
    <rect x="258" y="792" width="25" height="17" rx="8" fill="none" stroke="#000000" stroke-width="2"/>
    <polygon points="263,809 260,815 270,809" fill="#FFFFFF" stroke="#000000" stroke-width="2"/>
    <circle cx="266" cy="800" r="2" fill="#000000"/>
    <circle cx="275" cy="800" r="2" fill="#000000"/>
    <text x="270" y="834" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Roboto, Arial" font-size="11" font-weight="400" fill="#000000">Chat</text>
  </g>
  <g>
    <circle cx="342" cy="799" r="10" fill="none" stroke="#000000" stroke-width="2"/>
    <line x1="342" y1="789" x2="342" y2="809" stroke="#000000" stroke-width="2"/>
    <line x1="332" y1="799" x2="352" y2="799" stroke="#000000" stroke-width="2"/>
    <text x="342" y="834" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Roboto, Arial" font-size="11" font-weight="400" fill="#000000">Map</text>
  </g>
</svg>
